# Ultrasound Assisted RF Microneedling Technology.


### Revealing That Beauty Lies Just Beyond the Surface

[ Book Your Demo ][24]

UltraVision™ takes skincare to the next level by combining two technologies into one personalized
treatment. With industry-first ultrasound visualization and unmatched precision, UltraVision™ offers
ultrasound imaging, mapping, and an exclusive Uniform RF Microneedling delivery system. Your
patients will appreciate the precise and personalized results they’ll achieve.


Personalized Treatment Settings
Ultrasound Skin Depth Precision
Colorblind Versatility
Minimal Downtime
Uniform Energy Delivery

Having UltraVision™ in my practice is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made, not only for my
business but most importantly, for my patients.

**- Ashley Magovern, MD, Manhattan Beach, CA**

The latest and greatest of energy based microneedling is the UltraVision™. For practices who might
not have every device in the book, it’s really a jack of all trades.

**- Paul Jarrod Frank, MD, New York, NY**

## What Makes Us Different

Since 2016, Aesthetics Biomedical® Inc. has pioneered technologies that
are **precise**, **personalized**, and **safe**.

Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, we’re a privately-owned company that develops and manufactures
U.S. made technologies and products that offer novel aesthetic devices, products, and services in
the global market. Our innovation center is a leader in breakthrough technologies and combination
therapies for our clients, physician network, and the aesthetic arena.

Our goal is to provide your customers with personalized, precise, and safe treatments delivering
results they will love.

Delighted Customers.

UltraVision™ personalized technology, SoME® Skincare uses a proprietary blend of personalized
ingredients to offer a rejuvenating, custom at-home cosmetic experience.

## What Customer Say About

## UltraVision^{™}

There is something about UltraVision™ that is special – the downtime is significantly less than
regular microneedling. After multiple treatments, I feel like my makeup just glides over my skin.

I like to call it the Benjamin Button facial. It’s literally my go-to treatment.

**Jennifer Saviano, ABC’s The Bachelor & Bachelor in Paradise**

I recently completed my series of three UltraVision™ treatments and am thrilled with the results. I
am in my 60s but feel like my face makes me look closer to 40. As someone who has tried several
topical products and a few treatments, UltraVision™ is the one that has the most value and impact.
Some treatment areas feel smooth enough I don’t feel the need for injections. After my treatments, I
experience minimal redness that fades quickly. I plan to keep up with my treatments and hope to get

**- Karen M., 63 years old**

UltraVision™ is the first aesthetic treatment I have tried and am very happy with the results. After
each treatment, I notice my complexion appears more even and my skin feels tighter. As a busy mom, I
appreciate that there is minimal down time and I can go right back to any kid-related activities the
same day of my treatment, as long as I avoid the sun for twenty-four hours. My provider was able to
personalize the treatment settings to each area of my face and ensured I was comfortable. The
topical numbing cream made it virtually pain free and I loved how the cooling mask applied after
each treatment made for a relaxing experience.

**- Tracey T., 39 years old**

I have now had three treatments with the new device. Having had microneedling with other products
before, I thought I knew what to expect from the treatment, but this treatment was different. First,
I have had little to no redness, bruising, or tightness immediately following treatment. This was
huge, especially since I had appointments/meetings right after the treatments and did not have to
worry about the appearance of my face or having to schedule “down time”. The second difference from
previous treatments is that within two weeks of my first treatment, I noticed a difference: several
of my lines/wrinkles, especially my laugh lines, were not as deep. I could easily see the
improvement in the mirror. I recently was at my hairdresser who asked me what I had been doing, as
she, too, noticed my skin’s improvement. The treatment itself was painless, although you can
definitely feel it. All in all, I’m very happy with the results.

**- Debra P., 67 years old**

##### Revitalizing Health

Monica is passionate about helping clients restore their health through a root cause approach. She

Sciences and focuses on a functional medicine model.

[Schedule Consultation][9]

Monica Patel - Practitioner
Monica is passionate about helping clients restore their health through a root cause approach.

## Specialties

##### Areas of Focus

##### Environmental and Chemical Sensitivities

Some clients are sensitive to certain environmental or chemical elements that can be found in every
day products or by just walking outside. We can work with you to identify the root causes and
develop a strategy to help mitigate sensitivities.

##### Migraines

Migraines are a very common problem it is estimated that about 35 million people suffer from
migraines in the US alone. It is important to get to the root cause of migraines instead of
suppressing them with pharmaceuticals. Migraines are a sign that something deeper is going on in the
body. Symptoms are a way the body communicates with us. Once the root cause is addressed, the
migraines will get better and typically go away. 

##### Parasitic Infection

It’s a common misconception that parasites are only contracted from underdeveloped countries or from
eating sushi. They are a much more common problem than most people realize. They can wreck havoc on
the body and deplete nutrients as well as cause a host of symptoms such as skin issues, digestive
problems, inability to lose weight, and much more. Some common signs that a person might be dealing
with a parasitic infection is eye floaters, grinding teeth, food sensitivities, sugar cravings, and
symptoms worsening around the full moon. 

The way parasites can be contracted are from contaminated/tap water, pets (pets are usually dewormed
every so often), walking barefoot outside in grass or soil, traveling, fresh foods, and undercooked
meats.

##### Lyme and Co-Infections

Lyme Disease is often times misdiagnosed because it is known to mimic so many other conditions. Many
clients will often see about an average of 10-12 doctors, before they are correctly diagnosed with
Lyme. Some symptoms of Lyme include fatigue, fevers, rashes, joint and muscle pain, joint swelling,
stiff neck, headaches, dizziness, brain fog, and so much more. Despite the common misconception that
Lyme is transmitted solely from a tick bite, the world-renowned Lyme research expert, Dr.
Klinghardt, says it can be transmitted by infected fleas, lice, and mosquitos as well.

[Gut Dysfunction]

##### Gut Dysfunction

Having a healthy digestive tract is essential to having a healthy body. That is why our gut is known
as our “second brain”. When the gut microbiome is in dysfunction, it can affect our brain health,
mood, energy, skin, sleep, and even the immune system. There are many digestive disorders becoming
more and more prevalent, such as Crohn’s Disease, ulcerative colitis, irritable bowel syndrome,
gastroesophageal reflux disease, small intestinal bacterial overgrowth, constipation, and many more.
Getting to the root cause can help relieve symptoms and help restore the body into balance. As
Hippocrates best said, “All diseases begin in the gut.”

Clients struggling with chronic health issues can benefit from opening up their drainage pathways

We’ve all heard the saying “you are what you eat”, in a sense this is completely true. It is

### Tissue Regenix Group

Tissue Regenix Group is a pioneering, international medical technology company, focusing on the
development of regenerative products

[About Us][34]

### Our Vision

**Our vision is to establish Tissue Regenix Group as a leader in the science and innovation of
regenerative medicine. We are committed to transforming patient care and delivering favourable
health economic outcomes.**

[Our Technology][35]

### Our Mission

**Our mission is restoring patient function and vitality while honoring the gift of tissue
donation.**

[Donor Services][36]

### Regenerative Science

Regenerative medicine is an innovative and expanding field, researching the potential of tissue
engineering to offer a natural recovery by triggering a response through the body’s own cells, and
enable the natural regeneration of the patient’s own tissues.

[Read Our Story][37]

### Our Technology

We use our innovative platform technologies to address clinical needs in the regenerative medicine
market. Our technologies dCELL^{®} and BioRinse^{™} are complementary bone and soft tissue
platforms.

[Our Technology][38]

### **About Tissue Regenix Group**

Tissue Regenix Group are a leading manufacturer of allografts and xenografts processing products
that utilize our proprietary BioRinse™ and dCELL® technology platforms designed to enhance patient
outcomes.

We operate from two locations in San Antonio, Texas (formerly CellRight Technologies) and Leeds, UK.

Our San Antonio location processes, stores, and distributes Human Cells, Tissues, and Cellular and
Tissue-Based Products (HCT/P) to hospitals, medical professionals, and approved distribution
partners in compliance with the requirements of the FDA and state regulations, AATB Standards, and
other international requirements. We are AATB-accredited and registered with the FDA.

Our Leeds location houses our corporate offices and is responsible for porcine tissue medical device
manufacturing and distribution, including the OrthoPure® XT Ligament Reconstruction Implant. This
facility is certified to ISO 13485:2016. With strong connections to the University of Leeds, this
facility also acts as the research and development hub for potential future portfolio developments.

## Our Products

We focus on the development of regenerative products utilising our two platform technologies to
transform the treatment of patients and provide differentiated clinical outcomes in key clinical
areas.

## Manufacturer Partners

We partner with the top manufacturers in Regenerative medicine such as EmCyte and Tulip as well as

#### 5 Line Biologics

If you are faced with choosing between multiple distributors representing many of the same top
manufacturers, then as both a consumer and a clinician, you should have two basic questions. First,
can they decrease my overall costs? Second, are their standards as high as mine?

[ Read More ][19]

#### Our Approach

We understand how complex and confusing the regenerative medicine space can be.

[ Read More ][20]

Whether you’re brand new to Regenerative Medicine or have been here for years, we can help.

[ Get In Touch ][21]

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Here are some great questions you have on your mind!

Does a distributor need to be registered with the state of NJ to sell medical devices there?

Yes. [NJAC 8:21-3A][22] is the applicable statute. You can verify a distribution
business [here][23]. Our registration number is 5005403.

Does my practice require a blood bank license to prepare PRP?

Yes. Under the provisions of [NJSA 26:2A][24] you will be required to obtain a blood bank license
for perioperative autologous blood collection/administration. It is a fairly easy process and we are
happy to help guide you through this.

Please call us at [609-975-9884][25] or send an e-mail to [info@5linemed.com][26] to request more
information.

[[5 line Biologics logo][5 line Biologics logo]][27]

We provide full in-service product support. We also offer one-on-one training conducted through
partner physicians experienced with these types of procedures. We will provide this training in your
office.

Does a distributor need to be registered with the state of NJ to sell medical devices there?

Yes. [NJAC 8:21-3A][22] is the applicable statute. You can verify a distribution
business [here][23]. Our registration number is 5005403.

Does my practice require a blood bank license to prepare PRP?

for perioperative autologous blood collection/administration. It is a fairly easy process and we are
happy to help guide you through this.

## A Global Approach to Beauty

[ Book Now ][129]

Aère Aesthetics was built on the simple yet overlooked truth that beauty isn’t defined by a single
standard. It’s shaped by culture, heritage, perception, and evolution.

Our approach draws from advanced aesthetic techniques from around the world, including the
scientific rigor of Korean skincare, the structural refinement of Persian aesthetics, and the
injectable and energy treatments of the California coast.

preferences, and natural proportions. Every recommendation reflects a broader understanding of how
different cultures view beauty, expression, and aging. Whether you’re seeking soft refinement or
structural support, we select and deliver the global modalities that align with *your* beauty
ideals… all under one roof.

multistakeholder community of biotechnology companies, research institutions, patient advocates, and
strategic suppliers to shape regulation and policy, unlock access, and accelerate transformative
therapies.

## Advanced medical device technology to optimise clinical outcomes in autologous PRP and PRF
## procedures

Alocuro provides a comprehensive portfolio of medical devices, equipment & advanced training to
support clinicians for reliable preparation of patient-customised PRP and PRF.

Our systems are engineered to deliver autologous platelet preparations customised to each patient
with high-level purity, precision, control and clinical confidence.

ARTG-listed medical technology enables clinicians to consistently harness the regenerative potential
of the patient’s own biology, while minimising variability and inefficiency.

Built for modern clinical practice, Alocuro PRP supports a wide range of regenerative medicine
applications through standardised processing, flexible protocols and reproducible outcomes.

5 device sizes, 90% platelet collection efficiency, adjustable leukocyte inclusion, and a closed
sterile workflow provides clinician control to ensure the patient’s platelet collection matches
their clinical indication and treatment scope.

Visible platelets during every PRP collection provides confidence for clinicians of the sample’s
high platelet concentration, purity and customised precision.

the patient’s individual situation; considering patient’s baseline platelet count, clinical
indication, their individual medical history and treatment scope.

The PRP ‘formulation’ required for each patient’s situation is unique. For example, a chronic elbow
tendon pathology does not require the same ‘platelet dose’ as an osteoarthritic knee joint, or a
scalp experiencing hair loss.

  selected to match the clinical need
* Then either a ‘Leukocyte-Reduced’ or ‘Leukocyte-Rich’ protocol is used.
* Once platelets have been collected, the total PRP volume for injection or application, can be
  adjusted to suit the treatment scope, by including the appropriate volume of plasma.

## Why choose Alocuro medical devices?
1. **Clinician onboarding and support:** expert training, protocols, and implementation guidance for
   your practice and indication areas to optimise patient outcomes.
2. **ARTG-listed system:** designed for point-of-care PRP & PRF preparation, consistent platelet
   collection efficiency of 90%, after a 5 minute, single-spin centrifugation.
3. **Five platelet-concentrating device sizes:** 10ml, 15ml, 20ml, 30ml and 60ml, allowing
   customisable platelet dose, concentration and total PRP/PRF volume, tailored to the patient’s
   indication and treatment area.

   formulations, depending on the clinical application.

   clinicians to confidently verify the system’s delivery of 90% platelet collection efficiency.

   available). This level of reproducibility allows practitioners to reliably match platelet dose to
   clinical indication, and improve outcomes in tissue repair and recovery.
7. **Customisable output control:** to match treatment scope, including platelet dose, leukocyte
   content, plasma volume and resting or activated platelets.
8. **Clinical education pathways:** across all major practice areas, with ongoing training support
   and exclusive resources delivered via the Alocuro Clinician Portal.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

From employing the latest medical technologies to taking novel treatment approaches, our patients
benefit from our unwavering commitment to innovation across all mediums.

others with compassion and care.

## **Frequently Asked Questions About Scheduling**

**Q: How quickly can I be seen?**

A: Most patients are scheduled within one to two business days. For new acute injuries that need
same-day evaluation, we offer walk-in Immediate Injury Care at our Newburg Road campus in
Louisville.

**Q: Do I need a referral?**

A: Most patients can self-refer. Some insurance plans (particularly HMOs and certain Medicare
Advantage plans) require a referral — call 502-430-3689 to confirm your plan's requirements before
scheduling.

**Q: What insurance plans do you accept?**

A: Aptiva accepts most major commercial plans, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and workers'
compensation. Specific plan participation can vary by provider. Call [1-844-999-3627 (DOCS)][127] to
verify your plan before your visit.

**Q: What should I bring to my first appointment?**

A: Your insurance card, a photo ID, a list of current medications, and any prior records or imaging
related to your concern. We'll send you new patient paperwork in advance.

**Q: How long is a new patient appointment?**

A: New patient evaluations typically run 45-60 minutes. Follow-up visits are usually 15-30 min

## Our Mission

We are a forward-thinking functional and integrative health and wellness practice who work with men
and women to optimize their health.  Our mission is to give you back your health and your life
through education, empowerment, lifestyle optimization and evidence-based medicine. 

GET STARTED

## OUR PROCESS

Patients in our practice participate in our proven process. This proprietary system is the
foundation of our program; it isn’t found anywhere else in the world, and is how and why our
patients experience such phenomenal results.

### STEP 1: Advanced Labs

We initiate an extensive lab evaluation. We assess levels of sex hormones, thyroid function, growth
hormone production, diabetes risk, cardiovascular disease risk, and perform various genetic tests.
* Genetics
* Hormones
* Inflammation
* Cardiovascular health
* Diabetes risk

[Get Started][149]

### STEP 2: In-Depth Diagnostics

Beyond taking your vitals, our cutting-edge, in-house diagnostic equipment assesses arterial health,
screens for peripheral artery disease, and measures the electrical activity of your heart. We also
test bone density, measure visceral fat and determine your body composition.
* Body composition
* Bone density
* Arterial health
* ECG
* Overnight sleep study

[Get Started][150]

### STEP 3: Executive Physical

Our Executive Physical is a 4-part, holistic assessment designed to set up a personal program that
targets your health goals, improves your quality of life, and increases your health span. This
consists of: labs & diagnostics, an initial consultation, a cardiovascular assessment, and a
nutrition assessment & consultation.
* Initial consultation
* Cardiovascular analysis
* Sleep analysis
* Nutrition consultation

[Get Started][151]

### STEP 4: Customized Wellness Plan

Our practice truly individualizes care, which is a cornerstone of our practice. From the first
visit, you receive a wellness plan that’s tailored exclusively for you, based on: your health goals,
genetics, labs & diagnostics, and what’s medically appropriate. As you proceed, we add personalized
cardiometabolic and nutritional components as well.
* Adaptable
* Individualized for you
* Influenced by your genetics
* Customized to meet your goals

[Get Started][152]

### STEP 5: Ongoing Support & Wellness

We are committed to and pride ourselves in the extensive support we provide. As a patient, you have
ongoing access to our practice, providers, and network to ensure you reach your goals and optimize
your health. Your customized plan is reassessed, monitored and adjusted during the year, as
necessary.
* Medication and hormone management
* Supplement management
* Nutrition management
* Ongoing support from our team
* Open contact with your providers

хотели провести.
**2) Наш оператор записывает Вас** в общий график проведения МРТ в наиболее удобное для вас время, а
также, отвечает на все ваши вопросы.
**3) Оператор звонит** за день до исследования, чтобы **напомнить Вам** об исследовании и рассказать
как подготовиться к процедуре, если это необходимо.
**4) Вы приходите в наш центр** с паспортом на проведение МРТ(направление необязательно, но с собой
следует взять предыдущие исследования).

##### ACD-A+Gel

ACD-A+gel tubes contain an anticoagulant called acid citrate dextrose, which prevents blood clotting
and promotes the separation of blood components

##### ACD-A+Gel+HA

HA PRP TUBE contains hyaluronic acid, which is known for its healing and anti-inflammatory
properties.

##### **ACD-A+Gel+Biotin**

BIOTIN PRP TUBE contains biotin, which supports healthy skin, hair, and nails.

##### **ACD-A+Gel+Activator**

ACTIVATOR PRP TUBE contains calcium chloride and thrombin, which helps to activate the platelets and
increase the concentration of growth factors.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

# What is GFC PRP?

**GFC PRP (Growth Factor Concentrated Platelet-Rich Plasma)** represents an advanced evolution of
conventional PRP therapy. This sophisticated system isolates and concentrates platelet-derived
growth factors while systematically minimizing inflammatory cells, delivering a cell-free, highly
bioactive injectable solution.

The technology achieves superior regenerative outcomes through precision processing, making it the
preferred choice for discerning medical practitioners seeking predictable, reproducible clinical
results.

#### Higher Growth Factor Concentration

Enhanced regenerative potential

#### Reduced Inflammation

Improved patient comfort

#### Extended Activity

Longer biological effectiveness

Manufacturing Excellence

# Our GFC PRP Manufacturing Technology

As a dedicated PRP and GFC manufacturer, we follow rigorously validated production protocols
engineered for clinical excellence. Our manufacturing facility employs pharmaceutical-grade controls
to ensure every kit meets the highest standards of safety, sterility, and performance.

1

#### Precision Centrifugation Systems

Optimized protocols for platelet separation with minimal cellular trauma, ensuring maximum viability
and growth factor preservation.

2

#### Closed-System Processing

Hermetically sealed systems minimize contamination risk throughout the entire processing workflow,
from collection to final concentrate.

3

#### Standardized Protocols

Validated procedures ensure batch-to-batch consistency, delivering reproducible platelet counts and
growth factor profiles in every kit.

4

#### High Growth Factor Recovery

Maximized extraction of PDGF, VEGF, TGF-β, EGF, and IGF with documented concentration ratios
verified through laboratory analysis.

5

#### Medical-Grade Components

Single-use, sterile components manufactured from USP Class VI materials, eliminating
cross-contamination and ensuring patient safety.

Clinical Applications

# Applications of GFC PRP

Our GFC PRP systems deliver proven regenerative outcomes across diverse medical specialties. Each
application is supported by growing clinical evidence demonstrating efficacy, safety, and patient
satisfaction.

#### Hair Restoration & Trichology

Effective treatment for androgenetic alopecia, diffuse hair loss, and pattern baldness. Stimulates
follicular regeneration and improves hair density.

#### Aesthetic Dermatology

Comprehensive skin rejuvenation, acne scar revision, pigmentation correction, and collagen induction
for natural anti-aging outcomes.

#### Orthopedics & Sports Medicine

Addresses joint pain, osteoarthritis, and accelerates ligament and tendon healing. Reduces recovery
time for athletic injuries.

#### Gynecology & Reproductive Medicine

Supports vaginal rejuvenation, ovarian rejuvenation protocols, and endometrial preparation for
improved fertility outcomes in IVF procedures.

#### Regenerative Medicine

Broad-spectrum tissue repair and cellular regeneration applications including wound healing and
post-surgical recovery enhancement.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed

orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

    Hamandi Corp is a Design, Packaging and Manufacturer in the Medical Device section for
healthcare.



In Addition to contract manufacturing work, Hamandi Corp's expertise is in the development of
sterile, single-use blood collection systems for the collection, processing, and preparation of
autologous blood or bone marrow.

(CMO). We currently manufacture platelet rich plasma devices, medical instruments and devices,

## Принципы работы нашей клиники

Точная установка причины болезни
* Осмотр
* Доказанные методы
* Консилиум
* Наблюдение

[Подробный анализ снимков МРТ]

##### Подробный анализ снимков МРТ

Подробный анализ снимков МРТ, а не просто просмотр заключений.

[Тщательный неврологический и ортопедический осмотр]

##### Тщательный неврологический и ортопедический осмотр

Комплексная диагностика для выявления причин боли и ограничений движения.

[Только современные и доказанные методы лечения]

##### Только современные и доказанные методы лечения

Только проверенные подходы для эффективного и безопасного восстановления.

[Обязательное наблюдение состояния пациента после лечения]

##### Обязательное наблюдение состояния пациента после лечения

Контроль динамики и поддержка на всех этапах реабилитации.

##### Проводится консилиум

Консультация и лечение

При сочетаний заболеваний опорно-двигательного аппарата консультация и лечение пациента проводится
консилиумом в составе врача-нейрохирурга, невролога, травматолога-ортопеда, ревматолога,
эндокринолога и реабилитолога.

## Освободите себя от болей!

Мы поможем избавиться от болей в позвоночнике и суставах с помощью передовых методик лечения.
Обратитесь в нашу клинику для комплексного лечения.

## Памятка пациента

Нужно ли предварительно приезжать на консультацию?
Не обязательно, вы можете в один день проконсультироваться с врачом и сразу сделать процедуру, если
она вам показана.
Как проходит прием?

1. В самом начале врач проводит подробную консультацию и собирает анамнез. Консультация бесплатная.

2. Совместно с пациентом обсуждаются пути решения проблемы и еще раз проговаривается стоимость
лечения.

3. Выполняется процедура.

4. Даются постпроцедурные рекомендации.

Насколько заранее нужно записываться? Могу ли я приехать день в день?

Так как запись плотная, записываться лучше за 5-7 дней. Особенно на длительные процедуры, такие как
SMAS и RF-лифтинг.

Если нужная дата занята, администратор добавит вас в лист ожидания и, при наличии свободных окон,
перенесет запись на более удобное время.

Можно ли просто проконсультироваться с врачом?

Да, вы можете записаться только на консультацию и обсудить с врачом все волнующие вопросы: выяснить,
показана ли конкретная процедура, уточнить диагноз, подобрать домашний уход. Консультация
бесплатная.

Как убедиться в оригинальности оборудования?

Все оборудование в Jolly Clinic имеет регистрационное удостоверение Росздравнадзора. Аппараты
официально ввезены на территорию РФ и находятся на гарантийном и постгарантийном сервисном
обслуживании официальных дистрибьютеров. Эту информацию можно проверить на сайтах партнеров (список
ниже), в разделе «Где пройти процедуру», либо по телефону.

Также на ряд аппаратов есть официальные письма от поставщиков оборудования, можно запросить у
администратора.

Может ли врач отказать в процедуре?

Да, в следующий случаях:
* есть строгие противопоказания (после записи администратор высылает полный список, также с ним
  можно ознакомиться на сайте, внизу страницы с описанием каждой услуги);
* нет показаний к процедуре;
* пациент приезжает с герпесом, простудой или другим инфекционным/вирусным заболеванием (в этом
  случае прием можно перенести на другой день);
* пациент эмоционально нестабилен.

Возможен ли прием пациентов до 18 лет?

Некоторые процедуры, например лечение акне или удаление сосудов, мы выполняем пациентам начиная с 16
лет. В этом случае нужно письменное согласие одного из родителей.

Какая форма оплаты?

Наличные и карта.

Можно ли оформить налоговый вычет?

Да, для этого после приема обратитесь к администратору, и он подготовит пакет документов.

Есть ли парковка?

На территории Бизнес центра парковка не предусмотрена. В шаговой доступности расположено несколько
муниципальных парковок, на них обычно есть свободные места.

## Памятка пациента

Нужно ли предварительно приезжать на консультацию?
Не обязательно, вы можете в один день проконсультироваться с врачом и сразу сделать процедуру, если
она вам показана.
Как проходит прием?

1. В самом начале врач проводит подробную консультацию и собирает анамнез. Консультация бесплатная.

2. Совместно с пациентом обсуждаются пути решения проблемы и еще раз проговаривается стоимость
лечения.

3. Выполняется процедура.

4. Даются постпроцедурные рекомендации.

Насколько заранее нужно записываться? Могу ли я приехать день в день?

Так как запись плотная, записываться лучше за 5-7 дней. Особенно на длительные процедуры, такие как
SMAS и RF-лифтинг.

Если нужная дата занята, администратор добавит вас в лист ожидания и, при наличии свободных окон,
перенесет запись на более удобное время.

Можно ли просто проконсультироваться с врачом?

Да, вы можете записаться только на консультацию и обсудить с врачом все волнующие вопросы: выяснить,
показана ли конкретная процедура, уточнить диагноз, подобрать домашний уход. Консультация
бесплатная.

Как убедиться в оригинальности оборудования?

Все оборудование в Jolly Clinic имеет регистрационное удостоверение Росздравнадзора. Аппараты
официально ввезены на территорию РФ и находятся на гарантийном и постгарантийном сервисном
обслуживании официальных дистрибьютеров. Эту информацию можно проверить на сайтах партнеров (список
ниже), в разделе «Где пройти процедуру», либо по телефону.

Также на ряд аппаратов есть официальные письма от поставщиков оборудования, можно запросить у
администратора.

Может ли врач отказать в процедуре?

Да, в следующий случаях:
* есть строгие противопоказания (после записи администратор высылает полный список, также с ним
  можно ознакомиться на сайте, внизу страницы с описанием каждой услуги);
* нет показаний к процедуре;
* пациент приезжает с герпесом, простудой или другим инфекционным/вирусным заболеванием (в этом
  случае прием можно перенести на другой день);
* пациент эмоционально нестабилен.

Возможен ли прием пациентов до 18 лет?

Некоторые процедуры, например лечение акне или удаление сосудов, мы выполняем пациентам начиная с 16
лет. В этом случае нужно письменное согласие одного из родителей.

Какая форма оплаты?

Наличные и карта.

Можно ли оформить налоговый вычет?

Да, для этого после приема обратитесь к администратору, и он подготовит пакет документов.

Есть ли парковка?

На территории Бизнес центра парковка не предусмотрена. В шаговой доступности расположено несколько
муниципальных парковок, на них обычно есть свободные места.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

## BUSINESS

### 特定細胞加工物製造業

[詳しく見る][85]

### CDMO事業

医薬品医療機器等法（薬機法）に基づく再生医療等製品・治験製品の工程開発から製造受託までトータルサポー
トで承ります。

[詳しく見る][86]

### バリューチェーン事業

再生医療の細胞加工に携わるすべてのお客様の業務負荷を軽減するためのソリューションを提供し、円滑な再生
医療の実施を支援いたします。

[詳しく見る][87]

### 自己がん組織バンク

将来のがん治療に備えて、がんの手術などで摘出した患者さんのがん組織を無償でお預かりします。

[詳しく見る][88]

### 免疫細胞治療とは

免疫細胞治療は、自分の免疫細胞を使ってがんを攻撃する治療法です。メディネットは創業以来、免疫細胞治療
の技術開発に取り組んでいます。

[詳しく見る][89]

# Specialists in Orthopedic Care

**Jerome R. Friedland, MD**
[[Orthopedic Medical Center]][143]

Welcome to **Orthopedic Medical Center - Reseda** located in Reseda, and Westlake Village.  We serve
the San Fernando Valley and Southern California and specialize in arthroscopy, sports medicine and
joint reconstruction and aims to restore function and activity to patients with individualized care.
For more than 20 years, Orthopedic Medical Center has been helping patients achieve quicker
recoveries while, at the same time, making them feel special.

Our skilled physicians and surgeons are each well-trained in their specialties to provide you with
the finest orthopedic care. We also offer unsurpassed convenience.

We provide a wide range of orthopedic services, including:
 
* Platelet-Rich Plasma Injections
* Joint Reconstruction
* Arthroscopy
* Sports Medicine
* Biologic Joint Reconstruction
* Trauma Care

Our office believes that patient education is an essential aspect of achieving a successful
treatment, as full knowledge can help patients make informed decisions about their treatment options
with the help of their doctor.

Each and every one of our patients is given the attention and respect they deserve when they visit
the office. We strive to provide a warm and welcoming office environment, and someone is always
available and willing to assist you with any questions or concerns you may have. Our top priorities
are ensuring patient comfort and providing the highest level of orthopedic care that we can.

If you are interested in learning more about our doctors and the services we offer, please call the
office today at **818.708.8100** to schedule a consultation. We always look forward to seeing new
patients.
* Facet-Joint Injections
* Osteopenia
* Carpal Tunnel Syndrome
* Shoulder Instability
* Ankle Fracture
* Bunions
* Rheumatoid Arthritis
* Knee Arthroscopy
* Platelet-Rich Plasma Injections
* De Quervain's Tenosynovitis
* Orthotics
* Juvenile Rheumatoid Arthritis
* Plantar Fasciitis
* Syndactyly
* Achilles

Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP) is an injectable treatment, by which a person’s own blood is used.
Platelets are vital in the process of tissue healing, and the growth of new cells. PRP thereby
promotes collagen production, regenerates the skin tissue, and essentially re-energizes your cells

Who Can Benefit Of A PRP Treatment For Hair Loss?

PRP hair restoration has created improvements for people experiencing:
Early male- or female-pattern baldness (androgenic alopecia)
Thinning hair on the scalp or along the hairline, especially near the temples
Metabolically induced hair thinning or loss
Fine or thinning hairs in the eyebrows or beard
PRP treatments can also be used preventatively to maintain your hair’s thickness over time.
Panderma PRP kits are designed to offer high quality PRP every time.

How Long Do PRP Hair Loss Treatment Results Last?

Results often last 6 to 12 months, but this varies from person to person. It takes about 3 months to
see optimal results and determine whether you’ll need additional sessions to achieve your ideal
outcome. Studies have shown PRP can significantly increase hair count and hair density within these
first 3 months. Once you’re happy with your growth, you can maintain it with treatments once or
twice a year or more as needed. Panderma PRP advice you discuss this with your practitioner.

What Is The Downtime Like After A PRP Hair Loss Treatment?

There is little to no downtime involved, as the treatment only involves a quick blood draw and a few
injections into the scalp. It’s normal to experience some temporary soreness and redness near your
injection sites, but this typically resolves in less than a day. You can resume desk work, workouts,
washing your hair, and all other daily activities right away. Panderma PRP offers the results your
client deserves.

How Should I Prepare for a PRP Hair Treatment?

For at least 48 hours and up to a week before your treatment, avoid blood-thinning medications and
supplements (with your doctor’s permission), as well as NSAIDs, alcohol, and anti-inflammatory
medications. You do not need to shave your hair before your treatment. On the day of your session,
plan to arrive with clean hair free of any gels, sprays, or styling products. Please follow the
advice of your PANDERMA practitioner.

Why Should I Choose PRP Over Other Hair Restoration Treatments?

PRP is an excellent minimally invasive alternative to more involved hair restoration solutions, such
as FUT or FUE grafting. It involves little to no downtime compared to other options and stimulates
your own natural hair growth rather than patching in areas with grafts from elsewhere on the head.
While this treatment isn’t right for everyone, it can provide noticeable results for the right
candidates. Your Panderma PRP consultant will advice you on the best treatments.

How Is PRP Administered?

The treatment of PRP involves a fraction of blood, collected or ‘drawn up’ from the individual
patient into a syringe. The collected blood is then spun down in a special centrifuge to separate
its components. The platelet rich plasma is then reinjected, and/or micro-needled back into the
skin. Panderma is a high quality affordable solution for PRP treatments.

Why Panderma ?

Here at Panderma we offer you high quality, affordable products to achieve the results your clients
deserve. We are also partnered with Doctor Wellness ® and their multi location training academies to
deliver the gold standards in training.
You will also receive a free listing on the Doctor Wellness ® clinic finder to drive clients
straight to your door.
Our staff are here to assist you with client leaflets, social media post and stories, image libary,
consent forms and more.

Who Can Benefit Of A PRP Treatment For Hair Loss?

PRP hair restoration has created improvements for people experiencing:
Early male- or female-pattern baldness (androgenic alopecia)
Thinning hair on the scalp or along the hairline, especially near the temples
Metabolically induced hair thinning or loss
Fine or thinning hairs in the eyebrows or beard
PRP treatments can also be used preventatively to maintain your hair’s thickness over time.
Panderma PRP kits are designed to offer high quality PRP every time.

How Long Do PRP Hair Loss Treatment Results Last?

Results often last 6 to 12 months, but this varies from person to person. It takes about 3 months to
see optimal results and determine whether you’ll need additional sessions to achieve your ideal
outcome. Studies have shown PRP can significantly increase hair count and hair density within these
first 3 months. Once you’re happy with your growth, you can maintain it with treatments once or
twice a year or more as needed. Panderma PRP advice you discuss this with your practitioner.

What Is The Downtime Like After A PRP Hair Loss Treatment?

There is little to no downtime involved, as the treatment only involves a quick blood draw and a few
injections into the scalp. It’s normal to experience some temporary soreness and redness near your
injection sites, but this typically resolves in less than a day. You can resume desk work, workouts,
washing your hair, and all other daily activities right away. Panderma PRP offers the results your
client deserves.

How Should I Prepare for a PRP Hair Treatment?

For at least 48 hours and up to a week before your treatment, avoid blood-thinning medications and
supplements (with your doctor’s permission), as well as NSAIDs, alcohol, and anti-inflammatory
medications. You do not need to shave your hair before your treatment. On the day of your session,
plan to arrive with clean hair free of any gels, sprays, or styling products. Please follow the
advice of your PANDERMA practitioner.

Why Should I Choose PRP Over Other Hair Restoration Treatments?

PRP is an excellent minimally invasive alternative to more involved hair restoration solutions, such
as FUT or FUE grafting. It involves little to no downtime compared to other options and stimulates
your own natural hair growth rather than patching in areas with grafts from elsewhere on the head.
While this treatment isn’t right for everyone, it can provide noticeable results for the right
candidates. Your Panderma PRP consultant will advice you on the best treatments.

How Is PRP Administered?

The treatment of PRP involves a fraction of blood, collected or ‘drawn up’ from the individual
patient into a syringe. The collected blood is then spun down in a special centrifuge to separate
its components. The platelet rich plasma is then reinjected, and/or micro-needled back into the
skin. Panderma is a high quality affordable solution for PRP treatments.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care

преемственности и совместной работы на всех этапах: диагностическом, хирургическом и
восстановительном.

ПЛЕЧО.РУ это эффективность, надежность и безопасность современной Артроскопии!


Наша группа врачей специалистов по диагностике, лечению, реабилитации заболеваний и травм плечевого
сустава ставит своей задачей улучшение функциональных результатов лечения наших пациентов путем
преемственности и совместной работы на всех этапах: диагностическом, хирургическом и
восстановительном.

Кроме того, работая в составе международных исследовательских групп и участвуя во всех крупных
международных конгрессах в Европе и Америке, мы можем предложить нашим пациентам наиболее адекватные
современные методы лечения, включая авторские методики.


ПЛЕЧО.РУ-точная диагностика, детальное планирование лечения, малотравматичная и артроскопическая
хирургия, реабилитация и ЛФК.

## Does your PRP system really work?

Most clinics are not unlocking the full potential of platelet-rich plasma. Gel separator tubes trap
a significant proportion of platelets, often producing a concentration of only around 1×. Activators
containing bovine thrombin may also carry a risk of clotting disorders and immune reactions. The
result is a less effective PRP preparation, less predictable clinical outcomes, and patients who
don’t achieve the results they were hoping for.

Y-Cellbio PRP tubes and the RVC002 centrifuge were developed to solve this problem—delivering a
validated, consistent PRP preparation process that recovers platelets often lost by conventional
systems.

bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[Read →][18]
[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## About Our Practice

For more than 30 years, Texas Orthopaedic Associates has provided comprehensive orthopedic care to
patients throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex. Our team of board-certified orthopedic surgeons
and musculoskeletal specialists diagnoses and treats a wide range of conditions affecting the bones,
joints, muscles, ligaments, tendons, and spine.

With state-of-the-art offices near the Presbyterian Hospital campus in Dallas and convenient
locations in Plano, Fort Worth, Keller, and Weatherford, Texas, patients have access to expert care
close to home. We specialize in sports medicine, joint replacement, spine care, hand and upper
extremity treatment, foot and ankle care, fracture care, and general orthopedics.

At Texas Orthopaedic Associates, we believe surgery is not always the first answer. Our physicians
are committed to helping patients find relief through conservative, non-surgical treatment options
whenever possible, including physical therapy, injections, bracing, and lifestyle modifications.
When surgery is necessary, our team utilizes advanced techniques and state-of-the-art technology to
help patients return to the activities they enjoy.

Whether you’re dealing with chronic joint pain, a sports injury, back or neck pain, arthritis, or a
workplace injury, Texas Orthopaedic Associates is dedicated to providing personalized treatment
plans focused on restoring mobility, reducing pain, and improving quality of life.

## Our Services

Our expertise and depth of experience make us the definitive choice for your orthopaedic needs.
Whether you are a star athlete or just seeking increased mobility without pain, the physicians and
staff at Texas Orthopaedic Associates want to offer you the least invasive treatment methods
possible. We invite you to schedule an appointment and learn more about how we can work together to
improve your health and quality of life

[[Tablets]][21]

Type B (Phuket).

and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
